title: Absen Suci .
intro: Di luwa gunong-gunong masa, na saboh kisah bakti njang hana meu-ubah-ubah dan saboh amanah njang that brat sampoë jiwa njang peu-ék njan djeuët keu putôh. Lam siat watee rakyat meuputa u arah keubodohan dan meuh, sidroe tokoh teudong teuga-geuhôi awaknyan lom, geumeulakee keusabaran, dan geutanggong beuban janji suci. Nyoe keuh kisah sidroe nyang geupiléh jeuet keu peumbantu, wazir, ngon wali iman bak watèe absen suci. Jeuet neubuka identitas jiwa nyang teuga nyoe?
clues: Lon bagi darah sidroe nabi rajek njang ka geupiléh untôk peugah haba langsông deungon Allah ateuëh gunong suci.
Syedara lon pernah meulakèe bantuan bak Allah untuk peugah haba deungon trang keu sidroe zalim nyang rayeuk.
Lon geupiléh lé Allah untôk dong bak binèh sjèëdara ulôn sibagoë peumbantu dan wazir.
Geutanjoë bandum tahadapi sidroë peunguasa njang tirani njang djituntut supaja djikheun dewa njang paléng manyang.
Seudangkan syedara ulôn meututô deungon Allah ateuëh gunong, ureuëng geutanjoë djipeugot keudroëdjih saboh patong nibak meuh djih.
Ulôn nakeuh sjèëdara Nabi Musa, geu-angkèë lé Allah sibagoë wazir geuh, geuseubôt nan dalam Al-Quran.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
